models.name: AI Co-Mathematician
models._note: DeepMind agentic AI for mathematicians (Zheng et al, May 7 2026). FrontierMath Tier 4 = 48% SOTA. Interactive workbench for ideation/lit search/theorem proving.

models.name: OneManCompany (OMC)
models._note: Heterogeneous agent organization framework. PRDBench 84.67% success rate (+15.48pp over prior SOTA).

benchmarks.name: PRDBench
benchmarks.description: Product Requirements Document benchmark — evaluates agent systems on PRD generation and refinement tasks. Per OneManCompany paper (arxiv 2604.22446). Higher = better.

benchmarks.name: Full Duplex Bench (Conversational Dynamics)
benchmarks.description: Speech-to-speech conversational dynamics benchmark — measures pause handling, turn-taking, interruption handling, and backchannel handling. Weighted average of v1 + v1.5. Per Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech evaluation.

benchmarks.name: τ-Voice (Agentic Performance)
benchmarks.description: Voice agent task completion benchmark — replica customer service scenarios with domain-specific tools across Airline, Retail, and Telecom domains. Per Artificial Analysis speech-to-speech evaluation.
